message:
Qoid has built several notable projects:

1. Facial Expression Recognition System (2024) — an AI/ML project using Python, TensorFlow, Keras, and OpenCV. It achieved 66.9% accuracy on the FER-2013 dataset, a +15.2% improvement over baseline, and is deployed for real-time inference on Hugging Face Spaces.

2. Agent Status (2026) — an AI agent observability platform built with TypeScript, Node.js, SQLite, and WebSocket, offering real-time monitoring, provider health metrics, token analytics, and error intelligence dashboards.

3. AUREX — AI Style Intelligence (2026) — an AI-powered web app using Laravel, Python FastAPI, and MediaPipe that analyzes facial landmarks from selfies to deliver personalized style and outfit recommendations.

Would you like more details on any of these?
